title: Memory Under Interference: Context Utilization, Specification Confusion, and Inference Efficiency in Small Code Language Models

creators.name: Brahmbhatt, Dhruv
creators.affiliation: Independent researcher; IIT Madras student (no institutional endorsement)

description: Empirical evaluation of context utilization, competing computational specifications and estimated CPU-package inference cost in two small quantized code language models on HumanEval+-based tasks. Seven studies contain 5,528 main experimental requests. Post-hoc and censoring limitations, uncertain accuracy preservation and retention-policy confounding remain explicit. MemoryGraph is a separately evaluated synthetic retrieval prototype, without demonstrated end-to-end correctness or energy benefits.
notes: Publication-preparation draft for manuscript Version 1.1 / proposed package v1.1.0. DOI reserved; not confirmed published. Actual Times New Roman embedded in manuscript; licensed font files not distributed.
